letter:
I am appealing this Parking Charge Notice as the registered keeper of the vehicle LT12EST. The driver will not be identified.

I note that LIVE_TEST Parking Ltd alleges an overstay at LIVE_TEST Retail Park on 1 June 2026 and that the Notice to Keeper was issued by post on 20 June 2026 for a site in England and Wales. According to the statutory schedule for a postal Notice to Keeper, for an event on 1 June 2026 the deadline for delivery was 15 June 2026, whereas the presumed date of delivery of this notice is 23 June 2026, which is 8 days after the end of the applicable period. The Notice to Keeper was therefore not delivered within the statutory period for the postal route, so LIVE_TEST Parking Ltd has failed to satisfy a condition required to transfer liability to the registered keeper under Schedule 4 of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012. The operator has not established the identity of the driver and, as the applicable Schedule 4 requirements have not been satisfied, liability cannot be transferred to the registered keeper under Schedule 4.

The keeper states that the vehicle visited LIVE_TEST Retail Park for shopping, that the vehicle left the site, and that the vehicle later returned the same day, so the vehicle attended on more than one occasion. This account of multiple visits is inconsistent with treating the first ANPR entry and the final ANPR exit alone as one continuous stay. LIVE_TEST Parking Ltd should therefore review the complete ANPR sequence for LT12EST for the date of 1 June 2026, including all intermediate entry and exit records, rather than relying only on the two images reproduced on the Parking Charge Notice.

For the reasons above, LIVE_TEST Parking Ltd has not established keeper liability under Schedule 4 of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012, and as the driver has not been identified there is no lawful basis to pursue this charge against the registered keeper on that footing. I invite LIVE_TEST Parking Ltd to cancel the Parking Charge Notice FRONTEND_LIVE_TEST_CPPLUS accordingly.
